findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x_read, x_timeline, x_lists, x_extract, x_monitor, x_write, x_inbox · Private data: x_read, x_monitor, x_draws, x_write, x_inbox, x_profile, x_community · Public sink: x_read, x_search, x_timeline, x_lists, x_extract, x_monitor, x_draws, x_write · Destructive: x_draws, x_write, x_community.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x_read, x_timeline, x_lists, x_extract, x_monitor, x_write, x_inbox · Private data: x_read, x_monitor, x_draws, x_write, x_inbox, x_profile, x_community · Public sink: x_read, x_search, x_timeline, x_lists, x_extract, x_monitor, x_draws, x_write · Destructive: x_draws, x_write, x_community

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
